## This work (Р-223)

The only source is the owner's own Russian translation (no original in the library) — owner's decision Р-223. Your book is registered with edition `trusted`; its `pdf` field points to the owner's HTML (`*_Full_RU_v1.html`); the same text is in `Pdf\*_Full_RU_v1.pdf` (use it for page numbers: printed page = page of that PDF unless the pages print other numbers) and the owner's keeper summary `For_Keeper\KeeperBook_v1.md` (a pointer only). Pictures (maps, handouts, illustrations) are in the folder's `Images\`. Read the HTML/PDF text directly (`pdftotext -layout`), check numbers on the PDF page images.

- **Numbers are unverified (Р-223):** every statblock and every number comes from the owner's text; put `parse_uncertain` on records with numbers and say in `quality.notes` «оригинал не найден, числа не сверены (Р-223)». Russian text as in the owner's translation; flag `translated` (it is a translation). `name.en` from the owner's text where he gives the English.
- These are Innsmouth/Arkham scenarios: the official places and people of «Побег из Иннсмута» (`kb/locations/innsmouth*.json`, `pobeg-iz-innsmuta-ru`, shared `coc:location:arkham`, `coc:character:*` such as Zadok Allen, Jeremiah Brewster) exist — Grep first, link to them, never duplicate; changes to them only through proposals. Official Russian names win over the owner's spelling (his forms go to `aliases` through proposals).
- Records — book-scoped `<book_id>/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/<book_id>/<kinds>/`. Scenario record, every scene retold for play (`arc`), items, handouts, organizations, characters (statblocks as printed, Р-25; pregenerated investigators are characters of the book), creatures (`instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:*`), places (inside the existing cities; places outside a city under «Окрестности <города>», Р-209). Maps — `map` with the image (`app/maps/<unit>-<slug>.jpg`, from the owner's `Images\Maps` or `Images\Handouts`) and spots on every printed number/label (Р-206). New cities only in `kb/locations/`. New spells — draft them in your report. Dice with lowercase d everywhere (Р-27), metric units (Р-64).
- `axes.era` ["1920s"], `ruleset` "core". Keep scratch files in your own scratchpad subfolder named after your unit. Coverage: `checks/20261112-owner-translations/<unit>.md` — every heading → record(s), «не взято»; proposals `proposals-<unit>.json`.
